title: Glückauf-Vermessung GmbH
description: Glückauf-Vermessung GmbH (glueckauf-vermessung.de) is a German engineering and technical company based in Sondershausen, operating as part of the ERCOSPLAN Group and specializing in surveying and mine surveying (Bergbau-Markscheiderei). Its core business activities include geodetic support for the mining industry, geological exploration, and work related to salt and mineral deposits. The company provides services for surface and underground measurements, deformation monitoring, and the preparation of technical documentation for industrial projects.
